long_biography.plain_text:
Marco Casiraghi built his public career in engineering and construction in Monaco. He serves as president of ENGECO and FPMC, which operate in civil construction and real-estate development. ENGECO was founded by his brother Stefano in the 1980s; Marco's long presidency places him as an operator of the family enterprise rather than its founder.

Beyond construction, Casiraghi has used competitions to turn engineering theory into practical experimentation. He helped establish the Monaco Energy Boat Challenge and created student projects including Businessgames @ school and a mousetrap-car grand prix. His role on the challenge's jury continues a broader interest in renewable energy, marine propulsion and technical education, without making those activities his demonstrated principal source of wealth.

uncertainties.detail: No reviewed public registry names Marco Casiraghi individually as Principessa Vaivia's beneficial owner. The identity clears the threshold because the authoritative record provides the exact person relationship, independent marine reporting places the exact yacht with the Monaco Casiraghi family, and official sources identify one matching Italian Monaco-resident Marco as the family's engineer and ENGECO leader. The vessel source's loose phrase describing the family as Monaco princes is not reproduced as Marco's title.

Marco is Stefano Casiraghi's brother and Pierre Casiraghi's uncle. Stefano founded ENGECO and Pierre later acquired its majority stake. Those relatives' founding, ownership, royal connections, sporting history, other companies and wealth are not transferred to Marco; only sources explicitly identifying Marco support his dossier.

The family-company history establishes context but does not disclose Marco's personal equity, inheritance, gifts, compensation or outside holdings. Unknown is therefore the terminal classification for origin rather than an inference from surname, family membership or presidency.

Operator is supported by long-term presidency and executive leadership. Founder is excluded because Stefano founded ENGECO; Heir / family shareholder and Owner-operator are excluded because reviewed sources do not establish Marco's personal shareholding or transfer mechanism.
